info.title: Digital Me Form Management API
info.description: API for managing Digital Me form submissions, including form initialization, validation, and attachment handling.

servers.description: Digital Me Form Management API Server

post.description:
Initialize a new draft form with optional prefilled data.
Accepts form fields directly in the request body.
Returns form_id and edit URL for frontend.

get.description: Retrieve all forms with optional filtering and pagination.
Retrieve a specific form by ID with attachments.

put.description: Update an existing form (auto-save or manual save).

delete.description: Delete a form (any status can be deleted).

patch.description: Change form status with optional validity score and feedback.
